book.name: Aj Éfeso
book.title: Tuꞌj Pabl kye Nimil aj Éfeso

content: Jun qmujbꞌil qibꞌ tuꞌn Xewbꞌaj Xjan
Tuꞌnpetziꞌn, exla qa intinkuxa toj tze tuꞌn tpaj qAjaw, nchin kubꞌsin nwutza kyeꞌy tuꞌn kyanqꞌiꞌn, tzeꞌnkuxjo tuꞌn tbꞌant, a ayiꞌy o chi txokliꞌy tuꞌn Dios tuꞌn kyoka te te.
Kymutxsinku kyibꞌa, ex bꞌunin chi yoliꞌn. Kyyonkuy tajbꞌil qMan kyukꞌa txqantl nimil, ex kukx tzikyꞌxi kyuꞌn jun tukꞌa juntl, tuꞌn tqꞌaqꞌbꞌil kykꞌuꞌja kyxolxa.
Kyqꞌonka tilil, tuꞌn kukx tuꞌn kymujbꞌin te kyibꞌjiꞌy, a tzeꞌnkuxjo ma tzaj tqꞌoꞌn Xewbꞌaj Xjan tnukꞌbꞌil te qmujbꞌil qibꞌ.
Quꞌn junchꞌin Ttanim Dios, a t-xmilil Crist, ex junchꞌin Xewbꞌaj Xjan, ex junchꞌin qꞌuqbꞌil qkꞌuꞌj tiꞌj tkyaqil nqo ayoꞌn toj kyaꞌj, a tzeꞌnkuxjo xqo txokle.
Ex noq junchꞌin qAjaw at, ex junchꞌin qnimbꞌil, ex junchꞌin jawsbꞌil aꞌ, a noq mujbꞌinqe.
Ex junchꞌin Dios, a kyMan tkyaqil nimil, ex tibꞌaj qkyaqil, ex n-aqꞌnin tuꞌn qel wen, ex at qoj qkyaqil.
Me teyile junjunqe, exla qa junchꞌin t-xtalbꞌil Crist, ma tzaj qꞌoꞌn junxilchaq qoklin, a tzeꞌnkuxjo taj.
Tuꞌnpetziꞌn, ikytzin ntqꞌmaꞌn toj Tuꞌjil Tyol Dios:

content.text: Tej tmeltzꞌaj toj kyaꞌj, xi tiꞌn tukꞌa aye i kubꞌ tiꞌj tuꞌn,
tuꞌn kyxi tyekꞌin kywutz tkyaqil toj nintz qꞌij te tzaqpibꞌl.

content: Atzin jaꞌlin, ¿Tiꞌtzin ele yol lo, qa ma meltzꞌaj toj kyaꞌj? Atzin ntqꞌmaꞌn qa nej xkutz toj kyaꞌj, tuꞌn tkꞌuꞌl tzaluꞌn twutz txꞌotxꞌ.
Ex atzin xkutz, axsin xjaxjo najchaq kyibꞌajxi kyaꞌj, tuꞌntzin tnoj tkyaqil tuꞌn tukꞌa tkyaqil tqoptzꞌajiyil.
Ex ax xi qꞌonte toklin junjun tuꞌn kyok te tsanjil, ex junjun te yolil Tyol Dios, a nkꞌmoꞌnte Tyol, ex junjun te qꞌmal te Tbꞌanil Tqanil kolbꞌil, ex junjun te kyikꞌlel ex xnaqꞌtzil,
tuꞌntzintla kyok te taqꞌnil, tuꞌn kyajbꞌin kye txqantl, tuꞌn tchꞌiyjo Ttanim Dios, a t-xmilil Crist,
tzmaxi aj qpon qkyaqilx toj jun twutzxix qmujbꞌil qibꞌ toj qnimbꞌil, ex tuꞌn tel qnikyꞌ tiꞌj jniꞌ t-xilin Tkꞌwal Dios. Ikytziꞌn, qo okil te xjal tzꞌaqle, tzeꞌnkuxjo jniꞌ t-xilin Crist,

tuꞌntzintla mi qo okil tzeꞌnku kyekꞌwal, a jun paqx ntxꞌixpit kynabꞌl, ex jun paqx nchex lipe tiꞌj alkyechaqku xnaqꞌtzbꞌil, a nya toj tumil; ex nxi kyqꞌoꞌn kyibꞌ tuꞌn kykubꞌ sbꞌuꞌn kyuꞌnxjal, a ẍtijqe, a nchi chuꞌchin kyiꞌj, tuꞌn kyxiꞌ toj jun bꞌe te najin.
Atzin qe, qo yolin tiꞌjjo twutzxix tukꞌa jun yol te tqꞌaqꞌbꞌil kꞌuꞌjbꞌaj, tuꞌntzin qchꞌiy toj tkyaqil tumil, mujleqo tukꞌa Crist, ajo nejinel tibꞌaj Ttanim, a t-xmilil.
Ex noq tuꞌn Crist, tkyaqiljo t-xmilil tmujbꞌin tibꞌ tiꞌj, tuꞌn taqꞌin teyile tnej, tuꞌntzintla tchꞌiy, ex tuꞌn kyonin te kyibꞌ toj kyqꞌaqꞌbꞌil kykꞌuꞌj, tzeꞌnku taj.
Jun akꞌaj qchwinqil tuꞌn Kolil Jesucrist
Atzin kxel nqꞌmanjiꞌy, ex kxel woqxeniꞌn toj tbꞌi qAjaw, tuꞌn mi chi anqꞌiniꞌy tzeꞌnqeku xjal, a nya nimil tiꞌj Dios, a nchi anqꞌin tzeꞌnku ntqanin kynabꞌl, a ntiꞌ tumil.
Toj qxopin taꞌ kynabꞌl, ex najchaq iteꞌ tiꞌj akꞌaj chwinqil tuꞌn Dios, quꞌn ntiꞌ tumil toj kywutz, tuꞌn tpajjo tchꞌuẍil kyanmin.
Ma tzꞌel naj kynabꞌl te txꞌixwejil, ex ma txi kyqꞌoꞌn kyibꞌ toj kyachbꞌil, tuꞌn tkubꞌ kybꞌinchin tkyaqil wiq tzeqbꞌil, a nya wen.
Me atzin kyeꞌ, mi s-el kyxnaqꞌtzin ikyjo tiꞌj Crist.
Qalaꞌ ma tzꞌok kybꞌiꞌn te, ex ma chi xnaqꞌtzajtza, a tzeꞌnkuxjo twutzxix, a at tiꞌj Crist.
Tuꞌnpetziꞌn, tzeꞌnku nchi anqꞌintaqa ojtxe, kytzaqpinkjiꞌy ojtxe kyteꞌn, a ntiꞌ tajbꞌin, a ma kubꞌ sbꞌuꞌn tuꞌn kyajbꞌila nya wen.
Ex kytxꞌixpinksjiꞌy kyanmiꞌn ex kynabꞌla, tuꞌn kyoka akꞌaj toj tkyaqil.
Ex kyqꞌoꞌnksinjiꞌy kyteꞌn, a saqxix, a bꞌantnin tzeꞌnkuxjo taj Dios, tuꞌntzintla tyekꞌin jun kychwinqila twutzxix, a tzꞌaqle, ex xjanxix kywutz kykyaqil.
Tuꞌnpetziꞌn, mi chi nikyꞌin yola, qalaꞌ teyile junjun tuꞌn tyolin twutzxix kyukꞌa tukꞌa, quꞌn qkyaqilx ma qo ok te junxchꞌin Ttanim Dios, a t-xmilil Crist.
Ex qa ma tzaj kyqꞌoja, mi chi bꞌinchin ila; ex atzin qꞌoj mi txi kykꞌuꞌn ajxi tex qꞌij.
Ikytziꞌn, mi txi kyqꞌoꞌn ambꞌil te tajaw il.
Ex aye ileqꞌ, noqit mi chi elqꞌin, qalaꞌ tuꞌn kyaqꞌnin, ex tuꞌn tbꞌant jun tbꞌanil aqꞌuntl kyuꞌn, tuꞌntzintla tknet chꞌin kyuꞌn, tuꞌn kysipin kyukꞌa yaj.
Mi txi kyqꞌmaꞌn jun yol, a nya wen. Qalaꞌ i tokin jun yol kyuꞌn, a wen, a at tajbꞌin tuꞌn kychꞌiyjo txqantl, tuꞌntzintla at tkyꞌiwbꞌil Dios kyibꞌajjo aye nchi bꞌiꞌn tiꞌj.

Mi txi kyqꞌoꞌn ambꞌil, tuꞌn tbꞌisin Xewbꞌaj Xjan, quꞌn noq tuꞌn Xewbꞌaj Xjan, ma txi tqꞌoꞌn Dios kyechila toj kyanmiꞌn, tuꞌn tel kynikyꞌtzajila qa te Diosqiꞌy, ex tuꞌn kykotpaja tojjo tqꞌijil tzul te paꞌbꞌin.
Mi chi yoliꞌn kujxix kyukꞌa kyukꞌiy; ex mi txi kyqꞌoꞌn kyibꞌa toj kyachbꞌila; ex mi chi qꞌojiꞌn; ex mi chi ẍchꞌiꞌn tuꞌn kyqꞌoja; ex mi chi yasiꞌn, ex mi kubꞌ kybꞌinchiꞌn tkyaqil wiq il.
Qalaꞌ, chi okxa wen, bꞌunin kyanmiꞌn jun tukꞌa juntl. Kynajsinkuy kyila kyxola, tzeꞌnku te Dios ma kubꞌ tnajsin kyila tuꞌn Crist.
